use_case_name: Monitor Current and Past Auction Status

claims.content: The user switches the view from the default Hourly View to the Daily View using a button on the page.
The user chooses to filter the display to view only gemstone auctions, only jewelry auctions, or all auctions.
In the case of odd times due to scheduling or overtime bidding, items are tallied in the subsequent hour rather than their actual closing time.
If an item scheduled to close does not close due to active overtime bidding, the system does not display the 'All Auctions Closed' message for that hour until the last auction closes.
The page shows the closing date & time (broken down by hour), the total bids on all items closing on that date/time, and the total cost of all items closing on that date/time.

The page shows the # of items scheduled to close, the total # of bidders so far, the average unit cost per auction, the total number of bids placed so far, and the average number of bids placed per item so far.
